route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/s81hd_lane_p7m/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/s81hd_lane_p7m/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/s81hd_lane_p7m --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_s81hd_lane --macro-view physical/ref_tile/dscoll_lane_w_s8ng/views/dsfd_coll_lane_w_safe8_ntf > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: s81hd_lane_p7m (STW-S81c-COLLA2-VP 10-22, HEAD lane design (b), adapter clock that scales like the child's): p3m geometry, target = the child's routed TT boundary mean 698.4 (no new target value); per-leaf spine pads built from BUFx4 (the child's CTS buffer family) instead of HB4xp67 delay cells. Why: p3m..p5b pin-flop spread traded TT for FF (698.4: TT 28 / FF 115; 743.4: 61.5 / 85.2; 753.4: 67.9 / 81.3; 760.4: 82.1 / 67.2) because the adapter leaves carry ~700 ps of HB4 delay-cell pad chains (FF/TT ~0.70-0.75) while the child's closed tree is BUF + wire (FF/TT 0.81): any single target balances one corner. Pads made of the child's buffer family scale with the child, so the TT-balanced tree stays balanced at FF. Single ck port, RTL/ports/latency unchanged. Not chosen: hardening the adapter as its own child (a new hard kit to close first + a landed seam; kept as the successor if the pad-family fix misses 80). | prior: STW-S81c-HEAD-LANE 10-22 (successor of flat s81hd_lane_m/f: clock_rule FAIL, one 24.1k-sink root over 812 um, boundary spread TT 81.5/FF 83.0 (m), TT 112.9 (f)): HIERARCHICAL -- the lane body is the CLOSED hard child dscoll_lane_w_s8ng (own tree, routed boundary spread TT 73.5/FF 67.6; closure-loop 8151c3923 TT +9.95/FF +6.81 DRC 0), the adapter is parent soft logic on a balanced spine targeted at the child's boundary insertion. RTL, ports, widths, cycles unchanged (RELEASE FREEZE 10-22). Two-root flat variant (+ck_l port) parked NEXT-RELEASE (branch claude/s81-head-lane-p2-1021). MAIN: core face E, adapter band 129.6 um E.
